messages.content: I'd like to start the air purifying function in my living room, please set the air conditioner to 'AIR_CLEAN' mode with strongest wind strength, with monitoring.

function.name: ThinQ_Connect
function.description: Send a command to control an LG ThinQ appliance, such as an air conditioner, by setting various operation modes and target settings. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

body.description: A dictionary containing the settings and modes to control the LG ThinQ appliance.

airConJobMode.description: The current job mode of the air conditioner.

windStrength.description: The strength of the air flow.

monitoringEnabled.description: Flag to enable or disable air quality monitoring.

airCleanOperationMode.description: The operation mode for air cleaning.

powerSaveEnabled.description: Flag to enable or disable power-saving mode.

coolTargetTemperature.description: The target temperature for cooling in degrees Celsius. Valid values range from 18 to 30.

targetTemperature.description: The general target temperature in degrees Celsius. Valid values range from 18 to 30.

message.reasoning:
The user wants to start the air purifying function in their living room. They want to set the air conditioner to 'AIR_CLEAN' mode with strongest wind strength, with monitoring. The function ThinQ_Connect expects a body dictionary with keys: airConJobMode, windStrength, monitoringEnabled, airCleanOperationMode, powerSaveEnabled, coolTargetTemperature, targetTemperature.

We need to set airConJobMode to "AIR_CLEAN". For windStrength, the strongest is "HIGH". MonitoringEnabled should be true. airCleanOperationMode? The user didn't specify but likely we want to power on. So set airCleanOperationMode to "POWER_ON". powerSaveEnabled? Not specified, default false. coolTargetTemperature? Not relevant for air cleaning, but we can leave default. targetTemperature? Not relevant. So we call ThinQ_Connect with body: {airConJobMode: "AIR_CLEAN", windStrength: "HIGH", monitoringEnabled: true, airCleanOperationMode: "POWER_ON"}.

We need to call the function.
